zones.label: Mutual Respect
zones.summary: People value each other’s dignity, choices, identity, time, and goals.

zones.label: Open Communication
zones.summary: People can speak honestly, listen, and repair misunderstandings.
facts: Communication should not be demanded at all times.

zones.label: Boundaries
zones.summary: Clear limits are communicated and respected without punishment.
facts: Each person can maintain relationships and interests outside the relationship.

zones.label: Concerning Patterns
zones.summary: Jealousy, repeated pressure, monitoring, humiliation, or isolation are warning signs.
facts: Patterns matter more than a single imperfect moment.

zones.label: Control
zones.summary: Threats, coercion, stalking, forced access, isolation, or violence are unsafe.
facts: Abuse is the responsibility of the person choosing it.
Leaving can increase risk and may require a safety plan.

zones.label: Get Support
zones.summary: Trusted people and specialized services can help assess options and safety.
facts: Do not confront a controlling person on someone else’s behalf without a plan.
